title: Keep deduplicated maintenance feedback actionable
goal: Use the real maintenance intake to fix missing later-attempt evidence and complete the feedback-to-PR loop.

acceptance.requirement: Repeated attempts reuse one issue and preserve a link to the latest run.
A fresh real failure reopens an already closed matching issue; a diagnostic drill does not reopen a closed issue.
The public evidence distinguishes real remote results, diagnostic drills and unverified desktop Hook events.

nonGoals: Claiming a production incident from a workflow drill
